verdict.rationale: Antigravity Remote Control lets you securely connect to and drive Antigravity 2.0 desktop sessions running on your machines from any web browser. That covers starting a task on one machine and continuing it elsewhere. Background scheduled tasks and scheduled messages sent while you're away support leaving work running between sessions. Missing for 10: the evidence is a single first-party sentence, with no detail on setup, auth, or limits; nothing shows session state or history syncing so a task can resume on a different machine rather than only being remotely driven on the original host; and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
